messages:
marta: Anyone hitting SSL verify errors using the Python SDK + Dedicated base_url + corporate HTTP proxy + custom CA? Getting `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: certificate verify failed` only when I set REDWOOD_BASE_URL to our VPC endpoint. Works against hosted API.

alex_dev: Can you paste a minimal repro and env? async or sync client? Often proxy+truststore order or import ordering is the culprit.

marta: Sync repro below (very small):

```py
import os
os.environ['REDWOOD_BASE_URL'] = 'https://redwood-vpc.internal'
os.environ['REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE'] = '/etc/ssl/certs/corp-root.pem'
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='REDACTED', base_url=os.environ['REDWOOD_BASE_URL'])
client.generate('hello')
```

Error: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError thrown from requests when hitting VPC. If I remove REDWOOD_BASE_URL it talks to hosted and passes.

kevin_sdk: Thanks — couple of notes from prior runs: 1) Our sync path uses requests + urllib3 and pays attention to REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE when configured before import; 2) The async path (aiohttp) historically built a default SSLContext and ignored REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE when base_url was set because code took an alternate boot path.

marta: I tried the async client as well; async fails consistently, sync only fails if I import requests after setting envs (order matters). I can share a tiny dockerfile that reproduces both behaviors.

alex_dev: If you can attach the repro that'd be ideal. Also include HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY envs — corporate proxies sometimes intercept and present their cert; that's why custom CA matters.

kevin_sdk: I'll try to reproduce. If confirmed it's a bug, plan is to centralize SSLContext construction so both sync and async clients call the same helper that honors REDWOOD_TRUST_BUNDLE / REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and falls back to certifi. Also explicit tests for base_url code paths.

ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/428 — "respect custom CA when REDWOOD_BASE_URL is set" (triage label: high) :issue_opened:

kevin_sdk: Uploaded a quick branch with the fix candidate. You can test by installing the branch wheel: `pip install git+https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk@fix/ssl-baseurl-428`. It forces both clients to use ssl_util.build_ssl_context(...) which reads REDWOOD_TRUST_BUNDLE or REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE.

marta: I tested the wheel in my container. Async client now succeeds against the VPC endpoint, sync also good. Verified the cert chain from our proxy is accepted. :tada: One UX note — examples in docs still show setting REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE after imports which is brittle; we should call that out.

marta: repro docker snippet I used (attached inline):

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
COPY reproducible/ /app/
WORKDIR /app
ENV REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://redwood-vpc.internal
ENV REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/corp-root.pem
ENV HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:8080
RUN pip install git+https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk@fix/ssl-baseurl-428
CMD ["python", "repro.py"]
```

alex_dev: Great. Can we also add a quick note about import/env order to the DevEx docs and sample apps? That will save folks lots of time.

kevin_sdk: Agreed. Also noticed typing inconsistency in the Client signature: `base_url: Optional[str]` vs `BaseUrl` alias in other places — that causes noisy hints in IDEs when following examples. Filing a follow-up.

kevin_sdk: Created follow-up issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/429 — "typing: standardize base_url annotation + docs examples". Will add unit tests and update docs snippet.

sophie: QA note: once PR is merged to main, please add a small integration test in the dedicated CI job that exercises base_url + proxy + custom CA to prevent regressions. Marking thread for close after release note synced. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
